title: Graphite Under Compression: Shift of Layer Breathing and Shear Modes Frequencies with Interlayer Spacing
rights: Publicly accessible author preprint; raw PDF local-only, redistribution not asserted.
method: PBE plus Grimme vdW, harmonic finite displacement; not MP48 PBEsol.
preprocessing: Manual numeric transcription; pages 2 and 3 visually checked; no curve digitization.
fit_domain: Compression corresponding to 0-10 GPa; fixed-plane fit starts at d0=3.20 angstrom.
uncertainty_policy: Reported errors are fit errors; confidence/covariance and functional model error are not supplied.
